basic_info.description: Stunning, fully detached single family home situated on a quiet block in the highly desirable Forest Hill neighborhood. This split level home was built in 1957 with 4 bedrooms, 2 full bath and approximately 2150sqft boasting a logical floor plan with 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths on the upper level. The main level features the public living area including a spacious eat-in kitchen, large living room with fireplace and dining room with lovely hillside outlooks. The upper level features a welcoming primary suite with a huge walk in closet, access to the patio and garden and a chic, updated full bath. The 2 well-scaled additional bedrooms on this level are served by an updated full bath. Just a few more steps up, you'll find a very large 4th bedroom or family room with a closet that houses a wet bar or what could possibly be another full bath or second primary suite! The home features a lovely walk out patio and terraced garden with a variety of mature plantings, two car side by side parking and ample storage. Close to both West Portal and Irving Street shopping corridors, JP Murphy Playground, UCSF medical and a variety of public and private schools. Pride of ownership is evident in this very well maintained property.
